blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A 20-year-old college student from Bongabong, Oriental Mindoro, whose body was earlier found in a vacant lot in Barangay Sapul, Calapan City, is now being mourned by her school community as police intensify the investigation into her death. The Calapan City Police Station earlier reported that a woman’s body was discovered at around 1:15 a.m. on Saturday, Nov. 7, in a vacant lot along a road in Barangay Sapul. ‘Maru’ St. Anthony College Calapan City identified the victim as Maru in a statement, expressing condolences to her family and loved ones. “Our hearts mourn the loss […]...
